baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction ٱلَّيْلِ ... يَغْشَىٰهَا makes night the agent of a transitive action upon an unspecified feminine object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Night's darkness behaves as a moving upper layer: when its phase arrives, it overlays the pronominal field and restricts access to it without yet implying damage or permanence.

activation_trace.role: Night as the dark opposite of day supplies the temporal-dark layer and serves as the covering agent.
A veil laid over and concealing something supplies the contact geometry and makes the verb an external overlay on -hā.

changed_reading.before: Night coincides with an otherwise unspecified darkening.
changed_reading.after: Night is an agentive veil that advances over and withholds a feminine field from view.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same verb in يَغْشَىٰهَا can describe coming upon a person or place, while ٱلَّيْلِ can name entry into nocturnal activity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause can stage an encounter rather than a static screen: night enters, comes upon, or visits the pronominal object as an event with approach and contact.

activation_trace.role: Entering or undertaking something by night turns the temporal noun into an enacted phase rather than a passive background.
Coming to or frequenting a target supplies the approach relation and lets night arrive upon -hā.
The non-dominant mapped inventory independently preserves visiting or habitual arrival and keeps the encounter reading live.

changed_reading.before: To cover is only to place darkness over an object.
changed_reading.after: Night itself comes upon the object like a recurring visitor whose arrival effects the cover.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb يَغْشَىٰهَا admits an event that envelops and overtakes, while night supplies the expanding dark medium.
baseline_models.mechanism: The scale of covering enlarges from a surface veil to a total event: night takes the whole field, temporarily leaving no exterior vantage within it.

activation_trace.role: Night's darkness supplies the medium capable of filling the field.
An enveloping event that overtakes people supplies total scope and raises covering from placement to seizure.

changed_reading.before: Night places a bounded veil over something.
changed_reading.after: Night overtakes the entire referential field as an encompassing event.

context_deltas.mechanism: Solar exposure, lunar following, daylight opening, disclosure, and nocturnal covering form a relay of contrary operations over a recurring feminine field. Covering is therefore a phase-change that answers disclosure and remains answerable by it.

activation_trace.role: Night supplies the dark phase that takes its place opposite the exposed phase.
Veiling supplies the closing operation in the relay.
The sun and its radiance supply the primary exposing pole against which night operates.
Clear forenoon light supplies the state of maximal visibility that covering reverses.
The moon's light supplies a second luminous phase inside the larger alternation.
Following in sequence supplies the ordered handoff from one phase to another.
Day opening through light supplies an expanding aperture that opposes nocturnal closure.
Disclosure and appearance supply the exact inverse operation to veiling.

structural_cues: 91:1-4 repeat an oath noun followed by a feminine -hā, and 91:2-4 repeat idhā plus a transitive verb and -hā.
Packet order moves through radiance, following, disclosure, and covering without resolving the feminine referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies luminous phases, ordered following, opening, disclosure, and veil; I infer that these operations form a reversible relay over one functional field. A live alternative is that the four -hā forms have separate referents and only create formal parallelism.

changed_reading.before: Night's veil is a one-way loss of visibility.
changed_reading.after: Night's veil is one reversible turn in a patterned handoff between disclosure and concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following, succession, and repeated return strengthen the focus-only encounter model: night does not merely exist around the object but arrives in its turn, withdraws, and comes again.

activation_trace.role: Entry into nocturnal action supplies the enacted arrival of the phase.
Coming upon a target supplies night with the motion of a visitor.
The split-root visiting branch preserves recurrence and prevents the reading from collapsing back into mere opacity.
Following and serial arrival supply the procession in which night can take a turn.
Succession and replacement supply the recurrent after-one-another structure.
Returning again and again supplies periodicity to the visitor model.

structural_cues: The repeated idhā clauses in 91:2-4 present phases at the moment they act.
The focus verb takes a direct pronominal object, retaining the geometry of an encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, succession, return, nocturnal entry, and visiting; I infer a periodically arriving participant. The live alternative is the ordinary material-cover reading with succession belonging only to the surrounding sequence.

changed_reading.before: Night comes once and deposits a veil.
changed_reading.after: Night repeatedly visits -hā in its appointed place within a returning procession.

context_deltas.mechanism: An overhead expanse, construction by joined parts, the lower ground, and its spreading convert the veil into architecture. Night becomes a temporary roof or sheath laid across the extended field below.

activation_trace.role: Night's darkness supplies the material quality of the temporary roof.
A cover resting over something supplies the roof-to-field relation.
What rises above and shades supplies the overhead span that night can occupy.
Building by joining parts supplies the constructive assembly of an enclosing layer.
The lower counterpart to the sky supplies the surface over which the canopy extends.
Spreading and extending supplies the widening footprint of the night-cover.

structural_cues: 91:5-6 pair an upper object with building and a lower object with spreading.
The focus clause stands immediately before this vertical construction pair and already contains an agent-over-object relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an overhead shading expanse, joined construction, lower ground, spreading, and a cover; I infer a temporary canopy spanning the lower field. The live alternative is that night covers the sun rather than functioning as architecture over earth.

changed_reading.before: The veil is a local film touching an unspecified object.
changed_reading.after: Night is a temporary cosmic canopy constructed across an extended lower field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The affected field can now be modeled as the inward capacity of a formed living self. Night covers understanding in a reversible eclipse: access is suspended while the self remains intact.

activation_trace.role: Night supplies the recurring environmental phase under which awareness can be eclipsed.
Being overcome so that consciousness and understanding are covered supplies the internal effect.
The non-dominant mapped branch independently preserves loss of understanding and keeps the perceptual reading distinct from an outer veil.
The reason and inward awareness of the self supply the faculty being covered.
Completion and integral formation preserve the self beneath the temporary eclipse.

structural_cues: The feminine -hā recurs from the cosmic clauses into the formed self in 91:7.
The focus verb's object remains covered rather than grammatically erased or destroyed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies night, covered understanding, inward awareness, and an intact formed self; I infer reversible nightly suspension rather than annihilation. A live alternative keeps -hā wholly cosmic and treats the self sequence as a new object.

changed_reading.before: Night blocks an external observer's sight of an outer object.
changed_reading.after: Night can eclipse the inward self's access to understanding while leaving its formed integrity underneath.

context_deltas.mechanism: A cover can intercept a breach instead of merely causing blindness. Read beside rupture, self-protection, and growth, night becomes a guarded enclosure whose opacity may preserve an interior long enough for it to develop.

activation_trace.role: Night supplies the dark interval in which an interior can be withdrawn from exposure.
The veil supplies a boundary capable of intercepting as well as obscuring.
Deviation as piercing a cover supplies the invasive breach against which enclosure can function.
Repelling harm by a protective barrier supplies the defensive function of covering.
Placing the self within protection supplies an interior that the night-cover can shelter.
Growth and increase supply the process that protected withdrawal may enable.

structural_cues: 91:8 places breach and protection as paired possibilities belonging to the same feminine object.
91:9 immediately turns to that object's increase or purification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a veil, a pierced boundary, protection, and growth; I supply the arrow that temporary enclosure enables development. The live alternative is that protection and growth are purely ethical terms with no nocturnal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Covering is a neutral or adverse removal from sight.
changed_reading.after: Night's cover can be a defensive withdrawal that preserves the interior against breach and permits growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spread fertile ground, its plowing, hidden insertion, subsequent increase, and eventual fissure activate a seed-like material analogy. Night covering -hā can be incubation under a dark layer: concealment holds latent emergence rather than negating it.

activation_trace.role: Night supplies the dark interval analogous to the unseen phase of incubation.
The overlaid cover supplies the containing layer.
Soft fertile ground supplies a receiving and potentially generative substrate.
Spreading and extending supplies the prepared bed beneath the cover.
A wide splitting with outward release supplies the later emergence through the containing layer.
The cultivator who cuts the earth supplies the agricultural transformation of concealment into yield.
Increase and growth supply the latent process occurring beneath the cover.
Secret insertion into a hidden place supplies burial, whose value remains ambivalent until its outcome appears.

structural_cues: 91:6 introduces spread earth before 91:8-10 sequence fissure, increase, and hidden insertion.
The repeated feminine -hā lets the same formal object pass through covering, shaping, growth, and concealment without proving a single antecedent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fertile ground, spreading, splitting, cultivation, growth, hidden insertion, and a cover; I supply the seed/incubation analogy and the arrow from burial to emergence. The live alternative is adverse self-burial, in which concealment suppresses rather than germinates.

changed_reading.before: Whatever night covers simply disappears from present access.
changed_reading.after: Night may cover like soil: the hidden phase can hold a process that later splits its enclosure and grows.

context_deltas.mechanism: Overflow beyond bounds, an incapacitating strike, eradication, leveling, and punishment strengthen the focus branch of overwhelming affliction. Night's cover can be carried as a force that overruns the field, disables resistance, and leaves a leveled aftermath.

activation_trace.role: An affliction that envelops and overtakes supplies the total scope of the destructive reading.
Making a whip or sword strike come over someone supplies the forceful impact hidden inside covering.
Water rising beyond its limit supplies the mechanics of an overrun that exceeds containment.
Cutting an animal's legs supplies incapacitation at the point of support.
Eradication supplies the endpoint of total overtaking.
Equalizing supplies the leveled result left across the whole affected field.
Punishment following an offense supplies consequence as the trailing edge of the overrun.

structural_cues: 91:11-15 accelerates from boundary excess to individual movement, collective violence, total response, and aftermath.
91:14 chains actions with fa and ends in another feminine -hā.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overflow, a covering blow, incapacitation, eradication, equalization, and punishment; I infer one escalating mechanics of overrun. The live alternative is that 91:4 remains a benign cosmic phase while the later violence is a separate narrative register.

changed_reading.before: Overtaking is only the large spatial extent of night.
changed_reading.after: The cover can carry the latent force of an overrun: it comes over the field like a blow and leaves a leveled consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ordered following, an assigned share of access to water, and succession activate a distributive reading. Night covers -hā by assuming its allotted temporal turn over the shared field, then yielding to the next claimant.

activation_trace.role: A night deictically tied to the current day supplies a bounded temporal slot.
Coming upon a target supplies the act by which the phase assumes its turn.
Ordered following supplies a sequence of successive temporal claimants.
A share of watering and its channel supplies the concrete model of allotted access.
Replacement and succession supply the yielding of one turn to the next.

structural_cues: The opening sequence assigns each celestial or temporal noun its own action in turn.
91:13 explicitly attaches a feminine -hā to a watering allocation, creating a later distributive echo.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded night, following, coming upon, an allotted watering share, and succession; I supply the legal-temporal analogy that phases exercise turns over a shared field. The live alternative is purely visual alternation with no notion of entitlement or allocation.

changed_reading.before: Night covers because darkness physically spreads.
changed_reading.after: Night covers by taking its allotted shift over -hā within a regulated succession of phases.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus verb's sexual euphemism and reads later construction, birth, growth, and nurture as one generative chain. It remains valid as a lexical activation anchored directly in يَغْشَىٰهَا and several packet branches, but the syntax does not require intercourse; downstream prose should label it a branch-distant generative resonance, not an asserted antecedent or primary interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The direct-object construction يَغْشَىٰهَا is the exact focus form capable of carrying euphemistic conjugal covering.

activation_trace.role: Action undertaken by night supplies the temporal setting for the generative encounter.
Conjugal intercourse expressed as coming over a woman supplies the surprising focus-anchored relation.
Building upon one's wife and entering marriage supplies a transition from conjunction to formed household.
The coming forth of a child supplies the embodied consequence of generation.
Growth and increase supply development after generation.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion supply the sustaining end of the chain.

changed_reading.before: Night lays an impersonal dark cover over a field.
changed_reading.after: At the lexical edge, nocturnal covering can resonate as conjunction that initiates construction, birth, growth, and nurture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because night normally darkens, while the focus inventory also permits whiteness covering a face and the context supplies moon-white and clear-white light. It remains anchored in an explicit focus branch and the same cover geometry, but its animal-face scope is remote; downstream prose should present it only as a chiaroscuro or masking activation and must not identify -hā with the later she-camel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb's covering relation remains intact, but the covering substance is activated as whiteness rather than darkness.

activation_trace.role: Night supplies the expected dark ground against which the white-cover reversal becomes visible.
Whiteness covering an animal's whole face supplies a luminous mask while preserving the focus verb's overlay.
Moon-white coloration supplies a plausible nocturnal substance for the bright overlay.
The whiteness and clarity of day supply the opposite luminous pole echoed inside the nocturnal mask.
The explicit she-camel image supplies a remote animal-form resonance without fixing the earlier pronoun's antecedent.

changed_reading.before: The night-cover is uniformly black and subtracts all light.
changed_reading.after: A contained branch reading lets night carry a white luminous mask across a dark ground, so covering can mark by contrast as well as obscure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the focus verb's visiting and striking branches converge with the later protected female animal and her incapacitation. It remains anchored in the transitive focus verb, its explicit blow branch, and the repeated feminine object, but the packet does not say the later assault occurred at night or that the pronouns are coreferential; downstream prose should render it as ominous pronominal foreshadowing only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: In يَغْشَىٰهَا, an agent comes over a feminine object, and the focus inventory can make that coming-over an applied blow.

activation_trace.role: Nocturnal action supplies the possible cover or occasion under which an approach is hidden.
Coming upon a target supplies the approach to the feminine object.
Making a weapon or whip come over someone supplies the latent violent completion of that approach.
The she-camel's concrete form supplies the later feminine body echoed by -hā.
Her allotted watering share supplies the protected claim violated by the later action.
Cutting the animal's legs supplies the explicit incapacitating act that retroactively darkens the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: Night benignly comes over an unnamed feminine field.
changed_reading.after: As contained foreshadowing, the nocturnal coming-over can cast the shadow of an arriving blow against a later protected feminine body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it relocates covering from an outer surface to an inward seizure by using the non-dominant mapped disease branch, then links it to life-blood, inward awareness, and swallowing. It remains anchored in a supplied focus branch and an affected self, but the disease sense is form-distant from the clause; downstream prose should qualify it as a somatic analogy for engulfment, not a diagnosis or lexical disambiguation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping for يَغْشَىٰ includes a gripping condition that takes hold in the interior while still expressing overtaking.

activation_trace.role: An inner gripping condition supplies engulfment from within rather than a veil applied from outside.
Flowing blood as the support of life supplies the bodily interior in which the grip is felt.
Reason and inward awareness supply the faculty whose access can be engulfed.
Swallowing and taking something in fully supply the inward direction and totality of the seizure.

changed_reading.before: Night approaches from outside and overlays the object.
changed_reading.after: At the somatic edge, night-cover can model an inward grip that engulfs life and awareness from within.

strongest_changes: The sun-moon-day sequence revised a one-way veil into a reversible relay between disclosure and concealment.
Sky-building and earth-spreading gave the cover an architectural geometry: a temporary canopy across a lower field.
The formed self and the covered-understanding branches opened a distinct reading of night as reversible consciousness eclipse.
Rupture, protection, growth, fertile ground, cultivation, and hidden insertion split concealment into protective enclosure and risky incubation rather than one moralized meaning.
Overflow, striking, incapacitation, eradication, leveling, and consequence strengthened the otherwise exploratory reading of cover as punitive overrun.
Following, watering share, and succession activated a distributive reading in which night takes an allotted temporal turn.
summary.what_was_special: The compact focus clause sustained several non-equivalent mechanisms at once: surface veil, recurrent visitor, reversible phase, canopy, protected interior, incubating layer, and overwhelming blow. The split mapping of the focus verb and the repeated feminine -hā allowed context to change the mechanics without dislodging the reading from ٱلَّيْلِ ... يَغْشَىٰهَا.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent of -hā remains unresolved; repeated feminine pronouns create activation paths but do not prove coreference.
The relay is strongly patterned, but treating all opening operations as acting on one functional field is still a reader-supplied synthesis.
The canopy, protection, incubation, allocation, generative, luminous, violent-pronominal, and somatic models depend on explicit packet images plus abductive arrows not stated by the packet.
The late punitive sequence strengthens overtaking and striking but does not decide whether those branches belong to the focus clause or merely echo it.

The non-dominant mapped branches preserve real alternatives, especially visitation, covered understanding, conjugal covering, and inner gripping disease, but their form-distance requires visible qualification.
